note: POST-HOC diagnostic, NOT pre-registered; screen data only (track-H expert-corrected formulas, 40-item dev slice excluded). Same worlds and frozen reader prompt (v2); reader = Qwen3-8B with thinking ON, greedy, <= 2048 new tokens, batch 12.
screen_part: SKIPPED (time): with 51% of reads exhausting the token budget the screen AUROC would be dominated by fallbacks
reading: Reader capacity matters: on the same completed items balanced accuracy rises from 0.60 (non-thinking) to 0.79 (thinking), but stays below the 0.85 gate and costs ~9.5 s/item on an RTX 4090 with half of the items not finishing within 2,048 tokens. The world construction is readable by a reasoning reader; an 8B non-thinking reader cannot use it.
